GOOD TO KNOW

The sign-in page and sign-in emails now say "Yaxxa" rather than "Engagement Orchestrator". Organisations and resellers with their own branding keep their own name.

Nothing else changes unless Yaxxa AI PBX is in an organisation's plan and the server is told where the Phone system is.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

Phone system: where Yaxxa AI PBX is in the plan, people who may see or set up the phone system have a "Phone system" button in the app switcher. It opens in its own tab, and a call on its browser phone carries on while you move between screens. People whose role is only the phone system go straight to it when they sign in.

FOR PLATFORM OPERATORS AND RESELLERS

Two optional server settings: AIPBX_URL (the Phone system's address) and KEYCLOAK_EXTRA_WEB_BASES (other addresses the platform's web apps are served from, kept on the sign-in's allowed list). Unset, nothing changes.

Servers that install every release automatically now check for one every minute."}
